Unmodified script sections from Pokémon Essentials v17 (Peter O., Luka S.J.,
Maruno and contributors), taken from the public Pokémon Open Sky project
(github.com/Dordevic/Pokemon-Open-Sky). Settings.rb is trimmed to the screen
constants and set to Pokémon Myth's 640x480. Used only by tests/ruby/essentials.rb
to run Yami's runtime against the real Sprite_Resizer / Win32API code.
